attributes.title: 44th PAAV Annual Winter CME Conference
attributes.cme_provider: University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine (jointly accredited)
attributes.summary:
The Physician Assistant Academy of Vermont holds its 44th winter CME conference January 25 to 27, 2027, at the Von Trapp Family Lodge & Resort in Stowe. The University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine, a jointly accredited provider, handles registration and accreditation.

PAAV says registration includes 20 hours of CME; the formal credit designation is not published yet. Early-bird fees, which end December 15, 2026, are $590 for active or associate members, $390 for life members, $140 for student members and $790 for nonmembers. Rooms cost $265 per night with no resort fee, booked through a link in the confirmation email. Cancellations with a refund (minus $125) must arrive before January 4, 2027.

The agenda is now posted on the conference page.
